title: A cohomological invariant for algebras of degree 8 and exponent 2 in characteristic 2
summary: Our aim in this paper is to extend a work of Sivatski to characteristic 2. More precisely, for $F$ a field of characteristic $2$ and a central simple algebra $A$ of exponent 2 that splits over a triquadratic extension of $F$ of separability degree at least 4, we attach a cohomological invariant $\inv(A) \in H_2^3(F) / G$, where $H_2^3(F)$ is the third Kato-Milno cohomology group and $G$ is a subgroup of $H_2^3(F)$ divisible by the Brauer class of $A$.
